create_sandbox: create a Python sandbox with timeout, imports, hooks, and hook objects via factory
run_code_sandbox: run Python code in a sandbox and return SandboxResult with stdout and execution status
set_variables_sandbox: set variables in the sandbox using keyword arguments for key-value pairs
get_variables_sandbox: get variable values from the sandbox by name and return a mapping of name to value
parse_failure_details: parse failure details from a sandbox result dict into a FailureDetails object
